faq.question: Q1. What is the IIT Madras Project Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a temporary recruitment notification issued by IIT Madras for hiring 2 Project Associates in the Department of Electrical Engineering under Advertisement No. ICSR/PR/Advt.207/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for IIT Madras Project Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Associate post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIT Madras Project Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 20.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for IIT Madras Project Associate?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.E./B.Tech. degree in AI, AIML, CSE, ECE, or EEE with proficiency in Python, MATLAB, and AI/ML related tools.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the IIT Madras Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 32,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Madras Project Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for IIT Madras Project Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official portal at https://icandsr.iitm.ac.in/careers/current_openings.php.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the Project Associate contract at IIT Madras?
faq.answer: The appointment is initially for 6 months and is later extendable up to 15 months based on performance.

faq.question: Q9. Is an age limit specified in the notification?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an upper or lower age limit.
